# pidginhost_images (Data Source)

Lists the OS images available for servers. Use an image's `slug` as the `image` of a `pidginhost_server`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pidginhost_images" "debian" {
  family_name = "Debian"
}

# The default (usually newest) image of the family.
locals {
  debian_image = one([for i in data.pidginhost_images.debian.images : i.slug if i.is_default])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `family_name` (String) Only return images of this family, for example `Ubuntu` (case-sensitive).

### Read-Only

- `images` (Attributes List) The matching images. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--images))

<a id="nestedatt--images"></a>
### Nested Schema for `images`

Read-Only:

- `default_username` (String) Account the image provisions for SSH login.
- `family_name` (String) Image family, or null.
- `id` (String) Image ID.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the default version within its family.
- `name` (String) Display name.
- `slug` (String) Image slug, for example `ubuntu-24-04`.
